title: Epicraft Reborn
description: Public alpha test of the Epicraft Reborn modpack. This will be frequently updated as the community figures out exactly what it wants.
body:
This mod collection is made and maintained by the Epicraft team for Jinko's modded minecraft server.

The current version is a public alpha test to figure out the exact collection of mods the community is interested in playing.

---

The modpack is aimed towards explorers, with various dungeon generation mods and better combat to provide a rich adventure, and builders, helping make great bases with mods like Effortless Building.

It also includes a decent amount of performance mods like Sodium (with more getting added very soon), and lots of small quality of life features.



Some of the mods included are:
Alex's Mobs
Immersive Aircraft
Biomes O' Plenty
Deeper and Darker
Sophisticated Storage & Backpacks
Via Romana
Artifacts
Chipped
And many more!



This modpack is frequently updated with new features, bugfixes, and content.
